rule: A numerical PASS at an explicitly restricted order never becomes a model-wide experimental PASS. An uncomputed required observable is null, not zero.
model_definition: Zee scalar sector with Type-II quark Yukawas and general non-NFC lepton Yukawas needed for neutrino masses; not a fully natural-flavor-conserving Type-II lepton model.

entries.subject: Model and lepton Yukawa definition
entries.approximation: CP-conserving real scalar potential and Type-II quark sector; lepton Yukawas remain general
entries.justification: Florentino-Romão-Silva EPJC 81 (2021) 1148 Sec III explicitly restricts quark/scalar Z2 but does not analyze neutrino/LFV; Herrero-García et al JHEP04(2017)130 Sec2 notes general Zee needs two lepton-coupled doublets
entries.reviewer_objection: Calling the entire lepton sector Type-II natural flavor conservation is inconsistent with generating the required realistic neutrino masses
entries.allowed_claim: Type-II quark realization of the general Zee lepton sector

entries.subject: Scalar boundedness/unitarity/EWPO
entries.approximation: Tree-level BFB and perturbative unitarity, source EWPO approximation
entries.justification: Standard scalar phenomenology at tree potential and one-loop oblique order; 2021 reference applies similar scope
entries.reviewer_objection: Unreported stability scale and two-loop scalar corrections; EWPO central/covariance should be documented
entries.allowed_claim: Passes original source-defined tree-level/theoretical and EWPO screens at 16 fixed spectra

entries.subject: Vacuum stability
entries.approximation: D10 sufficient tree-level stationary point certificate for only 16 positive witnesses; other points may be UNKNOWN
entries.justification: D10 certified original tree-level potential global witness; 2021 study checks possible charge-breaking vacua
entries.reviewer_objection: A failure to find a sufficient witness is not exclusion; loop vacuum/metastability unknown
entries.allowed_claim: Original 16 source spectra have a sufficient tree-potential vacuum certificate

entries.subject: Neutrino masses and mixing
entries.approximation: One-loop Zee neutrino mass inverse, NuFIT central/secondary fixed oscillation target, exact algebraic closure but not global neutrino/cosmology likelihood
entries.justification: Leading Zee neutrino mass occurs at one-loop; 2017 full scan uses oscillation input and cosmology; native Module2 inverse source verified
entries.reviewer_objection: Neither one fitted central neutrino target nor a point in a nullspace demonstrates a statistically representative allowed region or cosmological mass-sum pass
entries.allowed_claim: Numerically reproduces chosen one-loop neutrino mass targets for 64 constructed families

entries.subject: Algebraic LFV suppressed textures
entries.approximation: Deliberately solve D_e_mu = D_mu_e =0 with four complex homogeneous parameters; remaining two complex free
entries.justification: Known Zee flavor-texture manipulation exists (2023 Heeck–Thapa, Eqs 14/18/19), so construction is not novelty
entries.reviewer_objection: Tuned or measure-zero textures not generic scan; require independent variations and discussion of naturalness/RGE
entries.allowed_claim: Exhibits deliberately constructed neutrino-consistent flavor witness families, not naturalness or acceptance fraction

entries.subject: Radiative charged LFV
entries.approximation: Full new-family source-replayed scalar one-loop radiative amplitudes plus named photon Barr–Zee contributions, tested for all 64 NO/IO algebraic textures. The remaining genuinely mixed Zee W/Goldstone two-loop dipoles and high-order gauge groups were not calculated.
entries.justification: Lavoura 2003 one-loop dipoles and Zee 2023 study discuss hierarchical relevant diagrams; selected source kernels validated, missing groups left null
entries.reviewer_objection: Cannot call physical µ→eγ PASSED if omitted leading or chirality-enhanced amplitudes remain unbounded
entries.allowed_claim: All 64 selected scalar-one-loop plus named two-loop radiative contributions are below the MEG II 90CL bound; no complete physical LFV pass

entries.subject: µ→3e and µ–e conversion
entries.approximation: For all 64 new-family full complex F,D Yukawas: actual neutral scalar μ→3e tree contact; actual τ→3μ and τ→3e tree contact; photon-dipole-only μ→3e diagnostic; Al dipole-dominance conversion ratio. Full signed photon monopole/Z/box and quark/nuclear conversion operators have NOT been run on these 64 cards.
entries.justification: 2017 full Zee scan includes both and their complementarity; original SARAH source validation at different Yukawa textures cannot be transplanted
entries.reviewer_objection: Muon conversion can exclude texture points with tiny radiative dipoles; direct-zero D_e_mu is not sufficient
entries.allowed_claim: Source-validated named new-family tree/dipole LFV subsets and explicitly unknown full one-loop μ3e and conversion

entries.subject: B→Xsγ high-scale matching
entries.approximation: Type-II quark top-only real two-state C_i weights cos²gamma and sin²gamma, with source-validated LO/NLO and independent HEPfit three-loop matching
entries.justification: 2021 model Appendix C, BMU matching, 2026 Misiak leading NP formula; two-state coherent matching verified
entries.reviewer_objection: Independent matching success is not a complete 2026 NNLO inclusive rate/uncertainty
entries.allowed_claim: Validated real top-only two-mass charged sector Wilson matching at specified orders

entries.subject: B→Xsγ exclusion statistic
entries.approximation: 2026 Eq4 linear leading-NP with independent exp ±0.19 and SM ±0.14 ×1e-4 combined Gaussian; explicit one- and two-sided alternatives; NP covariance unavailable
entries.justification: Misiak et al 2026 explicitly supplies leading BSM rate approximation; old 2017 paper discusses varied CL procedures
entries.reviewer_objection: Do not impose 670-GeV single-state bound on both masses or claim FC/calibrated 95% Zee exclusion
entries.allowed_claim: One- and two-sided Gaussian screening at published leading-NP order, with uncertainty limitations

entries.subject: h125 signal couplings and widths
entries.approximation: All 64 source-specific complete diagonal complex h125 lepton Yukawa modifiers, independently computed κV,κt,κb, LO ggF and native γγ/Zγ; matched-HDECAY known-channel positive-width sum. HiggsSignals source-pinned h125-only experiment-input pilot is separate and not a full Higgs sector acceptance.
entries.justification: 2021 paper performs μ_ij with full BRs; public HiggsTools requires complete model predictions and correct measurement options
entries.reviewer_objection: Using known-channel sum as Γtotal or passing a 125-GeV coupling proxy as a global Higgs fit invalidates acceptance
entries.allowed_claim: Recomputed h125 partial widths/complex couplings with width-independent observables; no official 95CL until HiggsSignals full-model input validated

entries.subject: Direct Higgs LFV
entries.approximation: Γ(h→ℓτ)/Γ(h→bb) conservative positive-partial upper envelope, compared with nominal ATLAS branching limits; production, total width and efficiency not recast
entries.justification: Positive partial widths imply Γ_total≥Γ_bb; published ATLAS branching limits derived under specified production assumptions
entries.reviewer_objection: ATLAS BR upper limits assume signal production and category acceptance; not an unconditional theorem for arbitrary couplings
entries.allowed_claim: Partial-width materiality check; no complete direct Higgs-LFV exclusion

entries.subject: Heavy neutral H/A and other Higgs searches
entries.approximation: All 64 source-specific H/A LO on-shell two-body positive decay sums including fermions, VV, hZ, hh, H_iW, charged pairs; open omitted tree channels flagged. QCD corrections/gg partials/offshell and actual HiggsBounds observed-search inputs are still not complete.
entries.justification: HiggsBounds chooses most sensitive observed limits using model production and branching predictions; missing channels cannot be passed as zeros
entries.reviewer_objection: Strong risk of excluded benchmark; complete rate and observed-limit recast needed to call it physically allowed
entries.allowed_claim: Tree-on-shell heavy H/A positive width floors and tautau BR upper envelopes, not physical total widths or observed-search exclusions

entries.subject: Charged cascade decay
entries.approximation: Complete native *on-shell two-body tree-level* D4 partial width ledger, excluding virtual three-body and NLO/QCD corrections
entries.justification: 2021 cascade formulas; D4 channel-source-tested widths on source scalar cards and new lepton textures
entries.reviewer_objection: Close thresholds or missed virtual/off-shell modes can alter branching fractions; do not claim NLO precision
entries.allowed_claim: Leading on-shell two-body cascade and H1→tb predictions

entries.subject: Associated charged-Higgs production
entries.approximation: Actual MG5 LO 5FS gb→tH2 with both charges, fixed µR=µF=mH2 and one LO PDF; numerical errors only
entries.justification: Validated pinned MG5 UFO D14D actual 13 TeV for all 16 scalar spectra and *actual* 14 TeV for 15591,2264,15673
entries.reviewer_objection: No 4FS/5FS matching, NLO K-factor, scale/PDF band or b-tag acceptance; 14 TeV rates cannot be interpolated to other 13 scalar points
entries.allowed_claim: LO parton-level rates with only numerical MC integration errors

entries.subject: Event yields and LHC/HL-LHC prospects
entries.approximation: Luminosity × LO inclusive sigma × on-shell tree branching product, pre-detector; no Z or top daughter decays unless explicitly multiplied
entries.justification: Identity for hypothetical inclusive event count; experimental sensitivity requires efficiencies and backgrounds
entries.reviewer_objection: N_raw is not a 95% CL exclusion or discovery significance; statistical CLs without B and ε is fabrication
entries.allowed_claim: Raw expected signal counts and required selection efficiency for a specified target count, no statistical reach

entries.subject: Scan representativeness and novelty
entries.approximation: Original 16 source-selected scalar spectra and 64 engineered neutrino textures are *not* a random or weighted global accepted volume sample
entries.justification: 2017 full general Zee scan and 2021 same-cascade paper are direct precedents; 2023 already constructs LFV-safe textures
entries.reviewer_objection: A paper claiming new allowed parameter regions or novelty from algebraic zeros alone is not sufficiently original, and selected-only scatter cannot support parameter-space conclusions
entries.allowed_claim: A finite controlled benchmark and rate/constraint correlation pilot; a production scan and novelty benchmark required before paper acceptance

entries.subject: Five-flavor heavy H2 production scheme and missing 4FS/NLO
entries.approximation: LO gg/gb-associated production in the five-flavor scheme, fixed muF=muR=mH2, one PDF; 4FS hard-bottom kinematics and 4FS/5FS NLO matching not calculated
entries.justification: Degrande, Ubiali, Wiesemann, Zaro JHEP10(2015)145 explicitly find NLO improvement to 4FS/5FS agreement for inclusive b but emphasize more robust hard-bottom kinematics in 4FS. Charged Higgs review EPJC77(2017)470 Sec6 describes Santander matching as cross-scheme recommendation, not free K-factor.
entries.reviewer_objection: A LO 5FS cross section with 0.2% integration error must not be marketed as a 0.2% prediction. Need at least muF/muR and PDF variation and ideally 4FS/NLO check before exclusion or detector acceptance.
entries.allowed_claim: LO 5FS baseline with explicit missing theory uncertainty, suitable for conditional pre-detector rate comparisons

entries.subject: Heavy neutral H/A exact source consistency and HiggsTools coverage
entries.approximation: New native heavy H/A on-shell tree two-body lower-width ledgers for all 64 flavor inputs are now computed, including tt, bb, charged H1W and open charged pairs; loop gg/gammagamma/Zgamma, full QCD width, all off-shell modes, observed HiggsTools direct searches and H/A production remain unqualified.
entries.justification: Existing HDECAY old-card benchmarks plus independent 2026-11-11 new-family native full disjoint on-shell tree channel ledgers; HiggsTools requires physical complete width and production. The conservative tau-tau width upper bound alone does not supply an experimental likelihood.
entries.reviewer_objection: H/A→H1W is large in the new 15673 tree ledger; all relevant hadron-collider heavy-neutral search final states and production/total-width inputs still need qualification before an observed Higgs exclusion.
entries.allowed_claim: Source-matched tree-level heavy H/A partial-width inventory and positive lower bound to total; no observed HiggsTools pass

allowed_now: Source-validated LO associated H2 production at 13 TeV all 16, 14 TeV three benchmarks
Neutrino mass-consistent, hand-constructed Yukawa textures under declared one-loop conditions
Leading-NP B screening and one-sided/two-sided sensitivity
Leading source-defined charged two-body branching fractions and transparent pre-detector yields
forbidden_without_new_evidence: Full HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds acceptance without total widths/production
95% CL LHC/HL-LHC exclusions or discovery sensitivity without backgrounds/efficiencies
First demonstration of H2→H1 Z or LFV-safe Yukawa textures
13-to-14 TeV mass-only rescaling for unintegrated spectra
